dataset.order: image groups (byte-identical duplicates merged) in SHA256(seed|group_id) order, questions within a group in SHA256(seed|question_id) order
dataset.note: plan §27: no stratification, no textprobe, no negation / answer-word / question-text exclusions, no relation or operation caps

model.name: qwen3.5:4b
model.decoding_note: A13 (plan §20) clean decoding sent with every request; think=false; no fallback model (fallback = the main model, qwen3.5:4b; no path switches to 9b)

roles.reader_lp: answer_only prompt + top_logprobs 10 (namespace lp); common scorer and B1
roles.reader_plain: answer_only prompt without logprobs; identity check only
roles.planner_v3: planner_v3, one text-only call per question
roles.observer_v3_lp: observer_v3 per item per level + top_logprobs 10 (namespace lp)
roles.direct_resolved: observer_v3 prompt on the ORIGINAL question + top_logprobs 10 (namespace lp_direct)

v27.confirmatory_rule: theta* = argmax dev balanced accuracy (strict), ties -> smaller theta; test number = balanced accuracy at theta*

model_swap.plan: §27.13 (2026-10-15): model-swap replication of the v27 DEV run with qwen3.5:4b (dev only; no test)
model_swap.sets_defined_by: same v27 extraction (same source files, filter, hash order, seed, dev 300 / <=2 per image), re-extracted into this run's own data_root; labels re-screened by qwen3.5:4b (reader_lp at L20)
model_swap.fallback_note: fallback_name is qwen3.5:4b itself: no path switches to 9b
model_swap.trailing_period_note: plan §26.1 (2026-10-11), same as configs/gqa_stop_v22_4b.json: qwen3.5:4b appends '.' after complete JSON; '.'/whitespace after a final '}' are removed for these roles only (rule trailing-period-v1, in their cache keys). observer_v3 covers observer_v3_lp and direct_resolved (same prompt role).
